test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

The doctor said, If you exercise regularly, you will feel better."

options.text: The doctor said that if you exercised regularly, you would feel better.
The doctor said that if he/she exercised regularly, he/she would feel better.
The doctor said that if one exercises regularly, one will feel better.
The doctor said that if one exercised regularly, one would feel better.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Direct Speech:** The doctor said, "If you exercise regularly, you will feel better."
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"you" becomes "one"**
